name: claudecast
title: ClaudeCast
description: Discover, resume, and automate Claude Code sessions: deep full-text search, one-keystroke resume, agentic loops, usage analytics, and quick prompts
author: qazi0

commands.name: ask-claude
commands.title: Ask Claude Code
commands.description: Quick prompt with context capture from VS Code

commands.name: browse-sessions
commands.title: Browse Sessions
commands.description: Find and resume Claude Code sessions

commands.name: deep-search-sessions
commands.title: Deep Search Sessions
commands.description: Search through full session content across all Claude Code conversations

commands.name: launch-project
commands.title: Launch Project
commands.description: Open Claude Code in a project

preferences.name: permissionMode
preferences.title: Permission Mode
preferences.description: Default permission mode for new sessions launched from this command

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model Override
preferences.description: Override the extension's default model for sessions launched from this command

commands.name: transform-selection
commands.title: Transform Selection
commands.description: Transform selected text with Claude Code

commands.name: menu-bar-monitor
commands.title: Claude Code Status
commands.description: Monitor Claude Code usage and status

preferences.name: showUsageInMenuBar
preferences.label: Show 5h Limit in Menu Bar
preferences.description: Display the percentage of your rolling 5-hour usage limit next to the menu bar icon. Falls back to today's token count if limits are unavailable. Updates every 30 seconds.

commands.name: usage-dashboard
commands.title: Usage Dashboard
commands.description: Detailed Claude Code usage and cost metrics

preferences.name: usageMode
preferences.title: Usage Display
preferences.description: Subscription shows live 5h/7d limit utilization and token counts — what a Claude subscription actually meters. API shows list-rate dollar estimates of what the same usage would have cost pay-as-you-go, and hides the limits section.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: The default Claude model to use for prompts

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal Application
preferences.description: Choose which terminal opens new Claude Code sessions. Each app uses its native AppleScript or CLI so launches are reliable across macOS updates.

preferences.name: openIn
preferences.title: Open In
preferences.description: Choose whether new Claude Code sessions open in a new terminal window or a new tab in the front window. Per-terminal notes: kitty New Tab requires `allow_remote_control yes` and a `listen_on` socket in `kitty.conf` (otherwise falls back to a new window). Warp always opens a new window regardless of this setting.

preferences.name: claudeCodePath
preferences.title: Claude Code Path
preferences.description: Path to the claude CLI binary (leave empty for auto-detection)

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Your Anthropic API key for pay-as-you-go billing (console.anthropic.com). Use this OR OAuth Token.

preferences.name: oauthToken
preferences.title: OAuth Token (Claude Subscription)
preferences.description: For Claude Pro/Team subscribers: Run 'claude setup-token' in terminal and paste the token here.

scripts.test: esbuild src/lib/subscription-usage.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --alias:@raycast/api=./test/stub-raycast.js --outfile=test/bundle.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/lib/pricing.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=test/pricing.mjs --log-level=warning && node test/parser.test.mjs
